lines.line: * When a debug build of palantir launches without the inspector launch flag
* Then it creates no inspector socket

problems.problem: These observations establish no discoverable listener, not that no socket was created. A non-listening socket at an unknown path, or one existing only between samples, can escape detection. The documented tools cannot establish their absence.

lines.line: * When it launches again with the flag
* Then it answers on a socket in a directory only the user can open

problems.at: Final expectation over up0 through up339: any(.exists == true and .isDirectory == true and ...)
problems.problem: Ownership and mode bits do not establish effective access when ACLs grant or deny access. This can accept a directory another user can open or reject one protected by ACLs. The documented metadata exposes no ACLs, so this is an instrument limitation.

summary: No blocking defects found. The steps match the example within the documented tools' observational limits.
